title: Stop Signs Suck and We Should Get Rid of Them
summary: Not Just Bikes argues that stop signs are a poor traffic control, drawing on Dutch practice and the Idaho stop to show intersections can be safer without them, especially for cyclists.
why: Cited in threads about cyclist safety and traffic law as an explanation of why removing stop signs can improve safety.

quote.text: Here is a great video about life without stop signs in the Netherlands
